News Release

EMBARGOED UNTIL RELEASE AT 8:30 a.m. EDT, Thursday, June 25, 2026

GDP (Third Estimate), Industries, Corporate Profits, State GDP, and State Personal Income, 1st Quarter 2026

Real gross domestic product (GDP) increased at an annual rate of 2.1 percent in the first quarter of 2026, according to the third estimate released today by the U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis.
